The first proper Cloudlight release!

Cloudlight lets you play your GeForce NOW games with a cleaner look, a couch mode for
controllers and settings that make sense. You still need your own GeForce NOW
membership.

## How to install

Download `Cloudlight-1.1.0-windows-x64.zip`, unzip the whole thing somewhere and open
`bin/Cloudlight.exe`. It isn't signed yet, so Windows may say the publisher is
unknown. Click "More info" and then "Run anyway".

## What's in it

- A whole new look in white, black and lavender, with a cloud logo and smoother
  animations.
- A couch mode for controllers that matches the desktop look.
- A simpler sign-in page.
- Your mouse cursor stays smooth while you play, like on a remote desktop, and some
  games' own cursors are drawn on your side too.
- Mouse input is sent at your mouse's full speed, so aiming feels more direct.
- The Ctrl+G menu works the way GeForce NOW's does, including its settings pages.
- Game filters, a network test and every streaming setting, all in one place.
- Games from the publisher's own launcher (like Wuthering Waves and Zenless Zone Zero)
  start properly.
- No tracking, no analytics and no Discord status.
- If Cloudlight ever crashes, it now leaves a crash note you can send in with a
  diagnostics report (Settings, then About).

## Good to know

- This release is Windows only for now.
- Some games with their own custom cursor might still show it the old way. Tell us
  which game if you spot it.
- On laptops with only built-in graphics, very high settings (like 1440p at 240 fps)
  can be more than the chip can handle. Dropping the frame rate helps.

Cloudlight is built on [OpenNOW](https://github.com/OpenCloudGaming/OpenNOW). It isn't
made or supported by NVIDIA.
